good_morning.native: អរុណសួស្តី
good_morning.note: Formal; most people just say soo-a-sday any time of day.

good_evening.native: សាយណ្ហសួស្តី
good_evening.note: Rarely used in speech; soo-a-sday covers evenings too.

how_are_you.native: តើអ្នកសុខសប្បាយជាទេ?
how_are_you.respelling: tae neak sok sa-bai chea te

sorry.note: Same phrase as excuse me; tone and a slight bow signal a real apology.

yes.note: Gender-based politeness particle: men say baat, women say chas.

cheers.note: Literally 'clink one' (glasses touching); said just before the first sip.
